title: First Consonants
description: Start with letter shapes and sounds, then practice recognizing them by ear.

title: More Consonant Sounds
description: Discover more letters, including sounds made with a puff of air.

title: Complete Your Consonants
description: Learn more spellings for familiar sounds, plus ng, n, m, y, r, l, and w.

title: Vowels
description: Short and long vowels, and where they attach around a consonant.

title: Sounds at Syllable Endings
description: Hear how a letter's sound changes between the start and end of a syllable, and practise the eight ending sounds.

title: Tone Rules
description: Explore how spelling predicts the tones you hear in words. No need to finish this before learning phrases.

title: Mixed Review
description: Everything together: all forty-four consonants, the vowels, and the full tone system.
